articles.headline: Joe Milton has huge game as Eagles shock Cowboys
articles.description: Dallas blew a 21-point lead as Philly made a spectacular comeback with Milton at the helm.
articles.headlineJa: ジョー・ミルトンが大活躍、イーグルスがカウボーイズに衝撃
articles.descriptionJa: ミルトンの指揮の下、フィラデルフィアが劇的な逆転劇を見せ、ダラスは21点のリードを守り切れなかった。
articles.body:
ARLINGTON, Texas -- Quarterback Joe Milton shined on the national stage, helping erase a 21-point third-quarter deficit to lead the Philadelphia Eagles to a thrilling 39-38 shootout win over the Dallas Cowboys to keep some hope alive in what's been a trying season.

Milton accounted for four touchdowns (three passing, one rushing) and made a number of "wow" throws with his howitzer arm, the bulk of which went to receiver DeVonta Smith, who erupted for 186 receiving yards and two scores. Milton did enough in the closing moments to set up a game-winning 59-yard field goal by Jake Elliott.

Any progress the defense made following quality outings against the New York Giants and Pittsburgh Steelers in consecutive games was stopped cold by a Dallas attack that was a clear step up in weight class, but the Eagles firmed up late to give Philly a chance.

Injuries hit, as they have all season, with running back Saquon Barkley (stinger), defensive back Cooper DeJean (concussion), tight end Dallas Goedert (shoulder), safety Marcus Epps (foot) and defensive tackle Gabe Hall (wrist) all forced to the sideline.

But with a pair of gettable games coming up against the Arizona Cardinals and Indianapolis Colts, it's not inconceivable the Eagles could turn this into a four-game winning streak as they attempt to climb out of the NFC East basement.

Here are the most important things to know from Thursday night for both teams:

Philadelphia Eagles (4-7)

What to make of the QB performance: The Eagles have something with Milton. He's shown playmaking ability in three starts since being signed off the Cowboys' practice squad last month, including a pair of long touchdown passes to Smith on Thursday. Showing off his ultra strong arm -- he wants to be called "Mr. Rocket" for a reason -- both TDs traveled 40-plus yards in the air. Jalen Hurts, who is out with blood clots, has five such TDs in his regular-season career, seven including playoffs. Philly should consider keeping Milton, who finished 21-of-31 for 331 yards, around beyond this season and continue to develop him.

Trend to watch: After getting gashed for 204 rushing yards in its first matchup with Dallas, the defense yielded more than 151 yards and three touchdowns on the ground in the rematch, including three first-half rushing scores by Javonte Williams. Philadelphia has been underwhelming as a rush defense this season, entering the game ranked 20th in average yards allowed per game (120.8).

Stat to know: Milton's 50-yard touchdown pass to Smith in the second quarter traveled 64.4 yards in air distance, according to NFL Next Gen Stats. It is the longest touchdown pass by an Eagles quarterback with that distance since the stat began being tracked in 2016. Packers quarterback Jordan Love's touchdown pass to receiver Christian Watson on Oct. 11 was 66.9 yards and is the only other NFL completion this season of 64-plus yards. -- Tim McManus

Next game: Dec. 6 at Arizona Cardinals

Dallas Cowboys (5-7)

articles.headline: Eagles' comeback against Cowboys stuns Jason Kelce, Caitlin Clark and more
articles.description: The Philadelphia Eagles pulled off the largest Thanksgiving Day comeback in NFL history.
articles.headlineJa: イーグルスのカウボーイズ戦逆転劇に、ジェイソン・ケルシーやケイトリン・クラークらが驚愕
articles.descriptionJa: フィラデルフィア・イーグルスが、NFL史上最大となる感謝祭の逆転劇を成し遂げた。
articles.body:
Prior to Thursday, Thanksgiving Day had never seen what the Philadelphia Eagles pulled off, and it stunned social media.

The Eagles defeated the Dallas Cowboys 39-38, wiping away a 21-point deficit for the largest Thanksgiving comeback in NFL history. 

According to ESPN Analytics, the Cowboys had a 99.4% chance to win after Brandon Aubrey's field goal gave Dallas a 21-point lead with 3:35 remaining in the third quarter. Instead, Philadelphia scored a touchdown on three of its next four offensive possessions. The Eagles also returned a blocked punt for a touchdown early in the fourth quarter. 

Dallas missed a 40-yard field goal with 3:27 left, and Philadelphia answered with another touchdown. It missed its two-point conversion, making it a 38-36 game. The Cowboys then turned it over on downs, and Jake Elliott nailed a 59-yarder to put the Eagles up for good -- capping a remarkable comeback.

The wild turn of events shocked the NFL world and beyond on social media, led by two former Eagles.

Former Eagles center and Super Bowl champion Jason Kelce headlined the reaction, posting a selfie with a caption that read: "F--- YESSSSSSSS!!!!!" His former teammate, Darius Slay, also chimed in, and former Cowboy receiver Dez Bryant offered his thoughts. Even Indiana Fever star Caitlin Clark reacted to the Cowboys' collapse, specifically the failed fourth-down conversion.

articles.headline: Jake Elliott's 59-yard field goal with 2 seconds left gives Eagles stunning 39-38 win over Cowboys
articles.description: — Jake Elliott kicked a 59-yard field with 2 seconds remaining, and the Philadelphia Eagles stunned the Dallas Cowboys by rallying for a 39-38 Thanksgiving victory on Thursday.
articles.headlineJa: 残り2秒の59ヤード・フィールドゴールで、イーグルスがカウボーイズに39-38の劇的勝利
articles.descriptionJa: ジェイク・エリオットが残り2秒で59ヤードのフィールドゴールを成功させ、フィラデルフィア・イーグルスは木曜日の感謝祭の試合でダラス・カウボーイズを追い上げ、39-38の劇的な勝利を収めた。
articles.body:
ARLINGTON, Texas -- — Jake Elliott kicked a 59-yard field with 2 seconds remaining, and the Philadelphia Eagles stunned the Dallas Cowboys by rallying for a 39-38 Thanksgiving victory on Thursday.


              The Eagles (4-7) got a chance for the win when Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer decided to go for it with a two-point lead on fourth-and-1 from the Philadelphia 39-yard line with 55 seconds remaining. Dak Prescott was sacked at the 48 of the Eagles, who needed just 11 yards to give Elliott a shot at the long field goal with 7 seconds to go.


              The shocking loss is sure to turn up the pressure on Schottenheimer after the Cowboys (5-7) again failed to win consecutive games and made any path to the playoffs difficult at best.


              Dallas' only winning streak in two seasons with Schottenheimer was a three-game run last November capped by a Thanksgiving win over Patrick Mahomes and Kansas City.


              The Cowboys led by 21 points in the third quarter and were still up 14 in the fourth before the Eagles started their improbable comeback by blocking a punt and returning it for a touchdown.


              Joe Milton had touchdown passes of 50 and 45 yards to DeVonta Smith and a 14-yard scoring run against his former team as the Eagles won when they were already missing quarterback Jalen Hurts and lost star running back Saquon Barkley (stinger) and cornerback Cooper DeJean (concussion) in the first quarter.


              The defending NFC East champions have won back-to-back games since a seven-game losing streak.


              Prescott threw for two touchdowns and ran for a score while Javonte Williams accounted for three TDs in a game the Cowboys didn’t trail until Elliott’s winning kick.


              The Cowboys were up 14 early in the fourth when Ty Robinson blocked Bryan Anger’s punt, and Kenny Moore II picked up the bouncing ball at the Dallas 3 for the easy score.


              Prescott answered by running through and vaulting over Moore on a 14-yard run that restored the two-touchdown lead.


              Dallas the had another special teams breakdown on Britain Covey's 55-yard kickoff return. Smith, who finished with a career-high 200 yards receiving, had a 23-yard catch after having gone to the sideline earlier with an apparent back injury when he landed hard on an incompletion. Milton ran 15 yards for a score on the next play.


              The Eagles went for a 2-point conversion and didn't get it, so they had to try again after Makai Lemon's 24-yard TD catch pulled them within 38-36 with 2:10 remaining. After a holding penalty, Milton's pass was broken up at the goal line.


              Before Lemon's score, Brandon Aubrey missed a 40-yard field goal that would have put Dallas up 11.

articles.headline: Brady disappointed in Rodgers' McCarthy comments: 'Nobody wins'
articles.description: Tom Brady expressed his disappointment in how Aaron Rodgers handled his exit from Pittsburgh, saying there are things in the locker room that shouldn't be made public.
articles.headlineJa: ブレイディ、ロジャースのマッカーシーに関する発言に失望「誰も得をしない」
articles.descriptionJa: トム・ブレイディは、アーロン・ロジャースのピッツバーグからの離脱の扱い方に失望を表明し、ロッカールームには公にすべきではないことがあると述べた。
articles.body:
Tom Brady expressed his disappointment in how fellow future Hall of Famer Aaron Rodgers handled his benching and exit from the Pittsburgh Steelers, saying "nobody wins when the family feuds."

Brady addressed the situation during the Fox broadcast of Eagles-Cowboys on Thursday, one day after Rodgers went scorched earth on Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy in a lengthy interview on "The Pat McAfee Show."

"[The] NFL locker room is a very sacred place, and we shouldn't ever lose track of that as players," Brady said. "It's a privilege to be in that locker room, when you're fighting with your teammates, you're fighting with your coaches, you're always acting as a team together. It shouldn't always be the place for private things to become public, that's what I'll say."

 

Following the news of his benching for backup Mason Rudolph, Rodgers went after McCarthy with a litany of accusations -- including that the coach has slept through team meetings -- and called into question his fitness to coach.

Brady called Rodgers a "tremendous player" but said the situation he created was "unfortunate." A seven-time Super Bowl champion, Brady reflected that it's his relationships with his coaches and teammates that he cherishes most from his Hall of Fame career.

"I was fortunate to be around a lot of great teammates over the years, and what made a great teammate to me was, you cared about your teammates and your coaches and you cared about what the team was trying to accomplish," he said. "And that supersedes any individual aspect of your game that you want to promote.

"I was in a great locker room. I played for my teammates, I played for my coaches ... nobody wins when the family feuds."

As for where the Steelers go from here -- team owner Art Rooney II has already backed McCarthy as coach -- Brady said the hope is they regroup ahead of Friday afternoon's game against the Denver Broncos.

"And all those teammates have to -- they're going to go and regroup and that's going to hopefully galvanize them toward, you know you feel like you're in the foxhole together," Brady said.

articles.headline: Jaylen Brown out against Pacers; Joel Embiid (illness) questionable
articles.description: The 76ers' Jaylen Brown (hamstring) is out for Friday's NBA Cup game against the Pacers. Joel Embiid (illness) is questionable.
articles.headlineJa: ジェイレン・ブラウンがペイサーズ戦を欠場、ジョエル・エンビード（病気）は出場が不透明
articles.descriptionJa: 76ersのジェイレン・ブラウン（ハムストリング）は、金曜日のペイサーズとのNBAカップの試合を欠場する。ジョエル・エンビード（病気）は出場が不透明だ。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- Philadelphia 76ers forward Jaylen Brown (left hamstring) will miss Friday night's NBA Cup game against the Indiana Pacers.

Center Joel Embiid, who has missed the last two games with an illness, is questionable.

After scoring his sixth point of Wednesday night's win over the Miami Heat on a step-back jump shot late in the second quarter, Brown immediately shook his head and grabbed his hamstring then signaled to the Sixers bench that he needed to check out of the game. The injury started for Brown in last week's win over the Brooklyn Nets in which he tied his season high of 31 points.

Brown left that game early because of a left hamstring strain and missed the Sixers' next two wins over the Orlando Magic and Milwaukee Bucks. He returned in Monday's loss to the Portland Trail Blazers, scoring 20 points. After that game, Brown said he had "a little bit of soreness."

For the season, Brown is averaging 21.4 points, six rebounds and 3.4 assists.

Friday's game is the final of NBA Cup group play. With a win, the 76ers will clinch Eastern Conference Group B and advance to the knockout rounds for the first time.

articles.headline: Man United-linked Dominic Calvert-Lewin signs new Leeds contract
articles.description: Leeds United have announced striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin has signed a new two-and-a-half-year contract with the club.
articles.headlineJa: マン・Uと関連のあるドミニク・カルバート＝レウィンがリーズと新契約を締結
articles.descriptionJa: リーズ・ユナイテッドは、ストライカーのドミニク・カルバート＝レウィンがクラブと新たに2年半の契約を結んだことを発表した。
articles.body:
Leeds United have announced striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin has signed a new two-and-a-half-year contract with the club.

The 29-year-old has kick-started his career since leaving Everton as a free agent in 2025 to join Leeds on a three-year deal following their promotion back to the Premier League.

He scored 14 top-flight goals last season and has five in 11 appearances this term, while his form at Elland Road has seen him recalled to the England squad.

The deal comes amid reports that Man United were potentially interested in the striker.

"Leeds United are delighted to announce Dominic Calvert-Lewin has signed a new contract with the club," a statement said.

"The England international has put pen to paper on a two-and-a-half-year deal at Elland Road, keeping him in West Yorkshire until the summer of 2029."

- Football's main character this week: Jude Bellingham is in a new stratosphere

- Man United's costly errors overshadow early progress under Mauricio Pochettino

Large chunks of Calvert-Lewin's nine-year spell at Everton were blighted by injury, but he missed only three league games last season and has started in all 11 top-flight fixtures in the current campaign.

He won the Premier League's Player of the Month Award in December after scoring in six consecutive matches.

After being recalled by England for a 1-1 friendly draw with Uruguay in March, Calvert-Lewin retained his place in Thomas Tuchel's squad for Nations League matches against Spain and Czechia.

His latest England appearance was against Spain earlier this month when he stepped off the bench to win his 15th cap in the Three Lions' 3-2 Nations League win.

Information from PA contributed to this report.

articles.headlineJa: 移籍の噂・ニュース：バルサとマドリード、アーリング・ハーランド獲得へ主導権争い
articles.descriptionJa: バルセロナとレアル・マドリードが、マン・シティのストライカー、アーリング・ハーランドの獲得に向けて動きを見せている。最新情報をTransfer Talkが伝える。
articles.body:
Barcelona and Real Madrid have hopes of signing Manchester City star Erling Haaland next summer, while the Catalan club are interested in a loan move for Manchester United defender Ayden Heaven. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Barcelona and Real Madrid are manoeuvring behind the scenes over a move for Manchester City striker Erling Haaland in 2027, according to TEAMtalk. Both Spanish giants are in regular contact through intermediaries as they remain hopeful that they can engineer a move for the 26-year-old. Liverpool, Bayern Munich and Paris Saint-Germain have also shown an interest in Haaland, but they and senior figures at the Etihad are aware that the Norway international wants to test himself in LaLiga.

- Ayden Heaven is open to a loan move away from Manchester United, and Barcelona are interested in the center back, according to The Sun. The 20-year-old has been left on the bench in both of Mauricio Pochettino's matches since the Argentine took over at Old Trafford. Fulham are also interested in Heaven, with Calvin Bassey having been linked with a January move going the other way, although that is deemed unlikely due to the 26-year-old's importance to the Cottagers.

- Arsenal, Tottenham Hotspur, Man City, AC Milan, Inter Milan and Juventus all had scouts watching Antonio Nusa as the winger scored a brace in RB Leipzig's 3-1 win over Lens, according to TEAMtalk. Atletico Madrid, Bayern Munich and Paris Saint-Germain are also interested in the 21-year-old. Leipzig are aware of the growing interest in Nusa and are working on a potential new contract for the Norway international, whose existing deal runs until 2029.

- Liverpool, Manchester United and Newcastle United are all interested in Juventus winger Francisco Conceição, reports La Gazzetta dello Sport. Jorge Mendes offered the 23-year-old to the Magpies for next June in a deal that could also allow Juve to permanently sign Nick Woltemade. Conceicao isn't thinking about his future and has even hinted at the possibility of staying with Juventus and trying to win trophies with the club.

- Napoli is the first club to make a move for Monza striker Gustavo Varela, but Juventus, AC Milan and Inter are also in the mix for the 21-year-old, reports La Gazzetta dello Sport. There are also various Premier League clubs following Varela, while Como could look to him due to uncertainty around Moise Kean's injury situation. For Milan, Varela is seen as an alternative to Club Brugge striker Nicolo Tresoldi, while Inter would only move in the summer.

Other rumors

- Manchester United's interest in Galatasaray striker Victor Osimhen has resurfaced. (TEAMtalk)

- Arsenal have added Club Brugge winger Carlos Forbs to their list of options for the January transfer window. (Football Insider)

- Liverpool could trigger their option to re-sign Bayer Leverkusen defender Jarell Quansah in 2027.

articles.headline: Liverpool captain Virgil Van Dijk lauds 'outstanding striker' Alexander Isak
articles.description: Liverpool Virgil van Dijk is expecting "fireworks" during Sunday's Merseyside derby and praised the impact of Alexander Isak and Florain Wirtz.
articles.headlineJa: リヴァプールのキャプテン、フィルジル・ファン・ダイクが「傑出したストライカー」のアレクサンデル・イサクを称賛
articles.descriptionJa: リヴァプールのフィルジル・ファン・ダイクは、日曜日のマーシーサイド・ダービーでの「熱戦」を期待しており、アレクサンデル・イサクとフロリアン・ヴィルツの影響力を称賛した。
articles.body:
Liverpool captain Virgil van Dijk is expecting "fireworks" from the first Merseyside derby of the season on Sunday, but on the pitch the pyrotechnics are being supplied by teammates Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz.

Liverpool could cap a significant spell with a third successive victory in eight days and fourth in-a-row after beating Manchester United last weekend and producing a perfect European away performance with a 3-0 Champions League win against Club Brugge.

Isak (two) and Wirtz scored the goals on freezing night in northern Belgium as their form starts to heat up heading into a pivotal part of the season.

The Sweden international, the club's joint British record signing, took his tally to 10 for the campaign as he became only the eighth player in their history to score in six consecutive away appearances.

Seven goals have come in the last 10 games and it is evident the striker's confidence is blossoming after a frustrating maiden campaign beset by injury but it not just the nature of his strikes -- illustrated by his run and chip over goalkeeper Yann Sommer for the third in Brugge -- which is catching the eye but his all-round contribution to the team.

"Hopefully there are many more goals to come. He's an outstanding striker. On and off the ball he's so important for us. His hold up play was so good, how he carried the ball," Van Dijk said.

"Sometimes when we had to go long, it was difficult for him to win the first ball but he was always there to fight and make it difficult for the defenders.

"It's difficult for me to say [what has changed for Isak] but confidence is massive.

"Staying fit, looking after yourself, knowing what the demands are to be a Liverpool player. Finding your importance in the team helps as well. Alex knows what we need from him and he's delivering that. I think it can only get better from here.

"Everyone has to understand each other's strengths and also sometimes their weaknesses in order to get the best out of each other. The process is going well.

- Liverpool are all smiles as Florian Wirtz, Alexander Isak start to click

- Man United's costly errors overshadow early progress under Mauricio Pochettino

- Iraola: Isak in a 'great moment' after brace vs. Club Brugge

"We are having a great week [but] I expect fireworks on Sunday, given Everton's result in their last game [a 10-man 4-0 defeat at Brentford].

"They are going to come up with a reaction, something comes out of that. You already know that."

Liverpool have won five and lost one of the last cross-city encounters and will make the short trip to Hill Dickinson stadium as favourites, especially after Everton's progress was somewhat abruptly halted by their chastening experience in west London.

Van Dijk scored the winner there in April in the 10th minute of added time and knows their rivals will be out for revenge.

articles.headline: Joshua Kimmich blasts Bayern Munich over Jamal Musiala treatment: 'Absolute no-go'
articles.description: Bayern Munich midfielder Joshua Kimmich has launched a stinging attack on the club's "not Bayern-like" treatment of his teammate Jamal Musiala, who has a condition which causes seizures.
articles.body:
Bayern Munich midfielder Joshua Kimmich has launched a stinging attack on the club's "not Bayern-like" treatment of his teammate Jamal Musiala, who has a condition which causes seizures.

Senior Bayern figures have publicly questioned Musiala's performances and contract after repeated seizures caused by a neurological condition, including two on the field in preseason games, drawing protests from players' union FIFPRO.

Now a key player has spoken out, too, and warned Bayern risks undermining its family image.

"What I don't understand is the way this is being communicated in public," Kimmich told reporters after Bayern's 2-1 Champions League loss at Lille on Wednesday.

"It must never happen that the burden is placed on a player. The club is obviously the top priority and bigger than a player, but it's not bigger than a person. That's an absolute no-go and it is not Bayern-like either."

Kimmich also questioned whether Musiala's run of injuries over the last two years, including a badly fractured leg at the Club World Cup last year, had more impact on his game than the neurological condition.

"It's not the case that he has problems because he's unprofessional. He's there every day trying to get the maximum out of himself," Kimmich added.

Bayern met with Musiala's agents Tuesday and clarified the timeline of events, dismissing speculation Musiala could have concealed the condition when he signed his last contract extension.

Bayern said the club and Musiala's representatives both accept he was first examined for seizure symptoms in April 2025, two months after the contract extension.

"This took place in consultation with FC Bayern and its medical unit immediately after the neurological symptoms first appeared," Bayern said.

Musiala went public with his diagnosis in August after collapsing on the field in two preseason games, leaving players and fans alarmed.

- Bayern Munich, Jamal Musiala mess shows German champs at their worst

- Bayern Munich: Jamal Musiala's health 'top priority' amid contract doubts

- Injury-hit Bayern beaten by Lille to suffer first UCL loss

Bayern coach Vincent Kompany said at the time the incidents were triggered by a change in the medication Musiala was taking. Musiala was rested for the start of the season and has since missed several games with a muscle issue.

Musiala came off the bench in the 76th minute of Bayern's loss at Lille, which continued a bad week for Bayern.

Ballon D'Or winner Harry Kane injured his ankle Friday and faces months on the sidelines, while Bayern have lost the lead in the Bundesliga to Borussia Dortmund and have now slipped to 15th in the Champions League standings.

articles.headline: Friday Night Lights,' 'Ted Lasso' top poll ranking 21st-century sports shows
articles.description: A Seton Hall poll crowns America's favorite modern fictional sports TV series.﻿
articles.body:
It's been quite the year for scripted sports series, with milestones worth celebrating and new chapters worthy of clearing space on the couch.

"Friday Night Lights" hit its two-decade anniversary. "One Tree Hill" turned 23 -- a number Nathan Scott and Michael Jordan would both approve of. On the more modern side, "Ted Lasso" returned for its fourth season, while "All American" wrapped up its Season 8 series finale.

Through different eras and sports, fans have plenty of reasons to get invested, so we tapped Seton Hall for a poll on America's favorite sports show of the 21st century.

"Friday Night Lights" and "Ted Lasso" took the top spots among the general population at 16% and 15%, respectively. The Texas-based football drama also held the edge among avid sports fans, 25% to 22%, and casual sports fans, 23% to 18%. 

"The two leaders in the clubhouse for top series indicate that depth and consistency resonate the most with all sports fans," said Len DeLuca, associate director, Seton Hall Sports Poll and instructor in the Seton Hall Stillman Center for sport management. "'Friday Night Lights' was on NBC 14 years before 'Ted Lasso' premiered on Apple TV. This proves that sports content is agnostic to platform."

Whether your loyalty lies with the Dillon Panthers, the Tree Hill Ravens or AFC Richmond, there's a good chance your favorite fictional team has put you through highs and lows. And much like rooting for a real team, picking a favorite show can inspire a spirited debate.

Here are the key findings.

Football leads a multisport lineup

 Among the general population, "Friday Night Lights" led all shows at 16%, with "All American" at 10%, "The Game" at 8% and "Ballers" at 7%. That gave football four of the eight highest-polling series overall. Viewers had plenty of interest in the drama surrounding the game, from high school rivalries to the business of professional sports.

Still, football didn't sweep the podium: Soccer's "Ted Lasso" and karate's "Cobra Kai" finished second and third at 15% and 13%, respectively. With 12%, "A League of Their Own" added representation for baseball and took the fourth spot. Hockey's "The Mighty Ducks: Game Changers" and basketball's "One Tree Hill" also drew 7% each, matching "Ballers."

The generation gap

 The age ranges didn't differ entirely, but different generations tended to root for different fictional teams.

18-34: "Ted Lasso" led with 17%, followed by "All American," "The Game" and "The English Game" at 14% each. Newer titles also found an audience here: "Heated Rivalry" drew 10%, its strongest showing across the age groups.

35-54: This group showed the most love for "Cobra Kai," which topped its list at 19%. "Friday Night Lights" followed at 18%, with "Ted Lasso" at 15%. "One Tree Hill" and "Eastbound & Down" also had their strongest showings here at 10% each.

articles.headline: Xabi Alonso: Wesley Fofana interview row 'closed' after apology
articles.description: Xabi Alonso called the matter "closed" after Wesley Fofana appeared to joke about Chelsea's Carabao Cup exit to Liverpool during an unauthorised interview.
articles.body:
Xabi Alonso called the matter "closed" after Wesley Fofana appeared to joke about Chelsea's Carabao Cup exit to Liverpool during an unauthorised interview.

The defender spoke for almost two hours with French YouTuber Zack Nani on a range of topics, admitting that he came close to quitting football whilst he was sidelined for most of the 2023-24 season with an anterior cruciate ligament injury.

It has been a particularly difficult spell for Fofana, who has been singled out for poor performances during the team's bad run.

He suffered an especially difficult first half during the 2-0 win over Manchester United, whilst he also conceded a penalty and missed in the shoot-out as Chelsea went out of the cup at Anfield.

His indiscretion in speaking publicly without the permission of the club could therefore not have come at a worse moment.

Chelsea have dropped to eighth in the Premier League ahead of Friday's trip to Nottingham Forest and both Fofana and defensive partner Levi Colwill were heavily criticised during last weekend's 4-1 hammering by Leeds, with Sky Sports pundit Jamie Carragher going so far as to claim the team will never win the league unless they make a change in central defence.

Alonso said the matter of the unauthorised interview had been addressed internally but would not confirm whether Fofana had been fined.

"We have addressed that with him," he said. "It was unfortunate. He has apologised. He knows it was not right, the moment, it was not right, the content. We are here to take things seriously. He's said it will not be repeated. We don't want these kind of things and they won't be repeated.

Asked if he considered the issue to be closed or whether there would be an internal ban, he said: "Closed."

Chelsea were bullied as Leeds ended their 27-year wait for a win at Stamford Bridge, a performance that was reflected in a chorus of boos for the players at the end of either half.

They continue to struggle in attack and in defence in the absence of injured pair João Pedro and Maxence Lacroix, neither of whom will be available for the visit to the City Ground.

However, Moisés Caicedo, whose withdrawal through injury in the first half against Leeds was a turning point after which Chelsea's afternoon fell apart, has trained and is fit to start.

Alonso was asked whether the mark of a top side is one that can withstand the loss of one or two of its best players and retain its identity.

"We missed not just players, we missed many basics to compete," he said. "That's been clear during the week, talking about how we need to have those basics in football to compete, to know what it takes to be ready. We will need that tomorrow. We missed it second half against Leeds.

articles.headline: Omar Marmoush hails Luca Williams-Barnett as 'unbelievable' after full Spurs debut
articles.description: Omar Marmoush has hailed Luca Williams-Barnett as "unbelievable" and believes the teen sensation has a "very promising future ahead of him."
articles.body:
Omar Marmoush has hailed Luca Williams-Barnett as "unbelievable" and believes the teen sensation has a "very promising future ahead of him."

The 18-year-old scored one, and set up another, on his full debut for Tottenham in their 2-0 home win against Ipswich last weekend.

Williams-Barnett has since signed a new deal to commit his future to Spurs until 2031.

"He is unbelievable," Marmoush said of the Tottenham academy graduate.

"He is a great, great talent and what I like most about him, of course his talent is something that everyone sees, is that he is very brave, too.

"And when he came on in his first game, he just took the ball and tried things. He is very direct, tries to beat his opponent and he has a very, very promising future ahead of him."

Speaking to Sky Sports, Marmoush continued: "He has got it, and you can see that. One of the big traits of a big talent, and a big player, is the personality and the character and that is what stands out most for me, his courage and to be brave.

"As a young lad to come into Spurs' first team and perform like that is not easy, and just to believe in yourself, and do the actions on your pitch is great. I hope he is enjoying it, and he will have a very, very big future, that's for sure."

- Tottenham prodigy Luca Williams-Barnett, 18, signs new contract

- Luca Williams-Barnett fell for under-21s joke before stellar Tottenham debut

Marmoush joined Tottenham on a season-long loan from Manchester City at the close of the summer transfer window, to follow Sávio, who completed a permanent £85m ($111m) transfer, out of the Etihad Stadium.

And reflecting on his move to north London, Marmoush, who has played 11 times so far for Roberto De Zerbi's improving side, continued: "Spurs are one of the biggest clubs in the world and in England.

"They have a big project and lots of ambitions and they are clear in what direction they want to go, and they are building towards that, and both me and Savio have the same in us -- a lot of goals that we want to reach and ambitions, too, so it suits us so well at this club.

"We were convinced by the project and we are very happy to be here.

"The boys are very happy. We are beginning to see the work we have put in come to life. The team spirit is very good right now, and we keep looking forward, and keep working."

Spurs will be aiming to build on their fourth win in five games -- which has lifted them to 10th in the Premier League table -- when they take on Sunderland at the Stadium of Light on Sunday.

articles.headline: Cesc Fàbregas plays down Barcelona links, pledges immediate future to Como
articles.description: Cesc Fabregas has pledged his immediate future to Como amid speculation that he could one day succeed Hansi Flick at Barcelona.
articles.body:
Cesc Fàbregas has pledged his immediate future to Como amid speculation that he could one day succeed Hansi Flick at Barcelona.

The former Arsenal, Barcelona and Chelsea midfielder has attracted the attention of several top clubs after guiding Como to an impressive start in the Champions League -- the Serie A side sit third in the standings, just behind Real Madrid and Paris Saint-Germain.

Asked about persistent rumours regarding a potential return to Barça after Como's 1-0 victory over AEK Athens on Wednesday, Fabregas told TNT Sports Mexico: "Obviously I'm from there [Barcelona.] I've grown up at that club and I know everyone there, but at the end of the day you have to take each day as it comes.

"Whenever I've tried to look too far ahead, it's never gone well for me. I'm the sort of person who takes each day as it comes.

"In life, we're like pilots flying a plane, and you never know when it's going to slow down. That's why we have to try and enjoy every moment."

Fàbregas, 39, has a contract with Como through June 2028. He reportedly has a clause in his contract that allows him to leave for Barcelona, Chelsea or Arsenal for very little compensation.

"I focus on the day-to-day because thinking about the future normally doesn't take you anywhere," Fàbregas said.

"I try to enjoy it knowing the competitiveness and the demand of being coach of a club like Como that is growing. I have so many responsibilities and I want to keep growing in this club, and above all, in my work."

- Meet Como's Nico Paz, the heir to Lionel Messi's Argentina No. 10 shirt

- Champions League upstarts Como suffer Moise Kean injury blow

Fàbregas played for Como for the 2022-23 season before retiring from football. As interim coach, he steered the club to earn promotion to Italy's top flight in May 2024 -- a third promotion in six seasons for the club.

Como finished fourth in Serie A last season to qualify for the Champions League for the first time in the club's history.

Wednesday's result was Como's fourth win in their opening five games in Europe's elite club competition. Amongst their standout performances include a 4-0 rout of Manchester United and a 9-1 demolition of Lens.

Como face Barcelona on Jan. 27 in the Champions League.
